description: Offensive shield melee - block rating is a damage stat here, Strength converts into it, and blocks feed Reprisal.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_guardian__gladiator.txt: 'retail Protection Warrior played in an offensive/PvP posture, a DPS-Prot hybrid'. The tree leans on the one thing that makes this spec unlike every other melee DPS - its stat priority puts Strength and block rating together, because 'Duty/One True Champion/Shield Training convert [Strength] into block rating'. Block is an offensive stat here.

nodes.name: Dirty Tactics
nodes.description: Increases your physical damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Armor Penetration (Dirty Tactics baseline +5%)'. No armour-penetration key exists, so it lands as flat physical damage - the same effect against a target with armour, without inventing a dead key.

nodes.name: Shield Combat
nodes.description: Increases your chance to block by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Shield Block maps onto the spec's block-scaling mitigation (Shield Training, Shield Combat, Bulwark Rush)'.

nodes.name: Gladiator's Resolve
nodes.description: Increases your Stamina by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: A DPS spec on a tank chassis still has to live through the fight.

nodes.name: Duty
nodes.description: Grants attack power equal to 3% of your Agility per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Agility (Duty converts Agility into bonus Attack Power)'. A real conversion key.

nodes.name: One True Champion
nodes.description: Grants block value equal to 3% of your Strength per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Strength (native Attack Power + Duty/One True Champion/Shield Training convert it into block rating)'. This is the spec's signature: Strength is simultaneously its damage stat and its mitigation stat.

nodes.name: Bulwark Rush
nodes.description: Increases the damage absorbed by your blocks by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA names Bulwark Rush with the block-scaling talents.

nodes.name: Battle Hardened
nodes.description: Reduces damage you take by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'a block-rating melee kit built around reactive mitigation, not passive sustain or HoTs'.

nodes.name: Glory
nodes.description: Your Ram builds toward a heavier strike, increasing your physical damage by 3% per rank for a short time.
nodes._source: CoA: 'banking Glory off Ram toward the increased hit'.

nodes.name: Improved Reprisal
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Reprisal by 12% per rank.
nodes._source: Reprisal is the spec's block-fed filler, so it is the right damage node.

nodes.name: Mortal Spear
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Spear Throw by 12% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: Spear Throw is 'Mortal Strike's anti-heal identity transplanted onto a shield-tank frame'.

nodes.name: Arena Veteran
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Arms Warrior burst identity is layered strongly on top'.

nodes.name: Favor
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 2 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'once Glory or Favor peaks' - the spec's second building resource.

nodes.name: Iron Will
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of stuns used against you by 15% per rank.
nodes._source: A PvP-leaning spec (CoA rates it Arena B) needs stun resistance.

nodes.name: Net Fighter
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: Net Throw into a kill window is the spec's PvP opener.

nodes.name: Centurion
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Centurion Strike by 12% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Centurion Strike (bigger hit, weapon-dependent bonus, extends Raise Shield)'.

nodes.name: Ruthless
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike damage by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: The burst half of the Arms layer.

nodes.name: Shield Slammer
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Ram by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Shield Slam/Revenge map onto Ram/Pulverize/Broad Sweep'.

nodes.name: Glorious Victory
nodes.description: Your critical strikes knit you back together.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Final Verdict's execute-range self-heal' and 'Lionheart's emergency heal' are the only sustain, so this is the tree's one sustain node - conditional, like CoA's.

nodes.name: Unrelenting
nodes.description: Increases your threat generation by 4% per rank, and your attack power by 3%.
nodes._source: CoA calls Gladiator 'a DPS-Prot hybrid' that can hold aggro when it has to - half the Vanguard's threat.

nodes.name: Heroic Fury
nodes.description: Increases your attack power by 4% per rank.

nodes.name: Last Man Standing
nodes.description: While below 35% health, you deal 8% more damage per rank.
nodes._source: The arena finish: it gets more dangerous as it drops.

nodes.name: Shield of the Arena
nodes.description: Increases your Armor by 5% and block chance by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Champion of the Arena
nodes.description: The crowd has already decided how this ends.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA: 'Weak sustained single-target DPS on patchwork fights - high throughput ceiling', so the payoff is a burst window rather than passive damage.
